**Pacific Seri Freight Sdn. Bhd. – Quick Vetting Summary** | **Aspect** | **Key Points** | |------------|----------------| | **Company basics** | **Name:** Pacific Seri Freight Sdn. Bhd.
**Registration No.:** SYN‑001203
**Status:** Active
**Type:** Private limited company
**Incorporated:** 8 Jun 2007
**Location:** Selangor, Malaysia | | **Industry & focus** | **Sector:** Logistics
**Core business:** Cold‑chain transport & storage of frozen goods (temperature‑controlled freight). | | **Ownership & control** | **Major shareholder:** Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd. (70 % – Malaysian‑registered)
**Individual shareholders:**
• Director 2 – 19.45 %
• Director 1 – 10.55 % | | **Leadership** | • **Managing Director:** Director 1 (appointed 12 Dec 2010)
• **Director:** Director 2 (appointed 21 Jun 2018) | | **Financial snapshot** | No financial statements provided in the record (empty “years” array). | | **Litigation history** | **One recent case** – *CASE‑2023‑0273* (Breach of contract, plaintiff, Magistrates’ Court Selangor). Filed 24 Sep 2023, **settled**; claim amount RM 22,500. No ongoing disputes. | | **Red flags / considerations** | • Lack of disclosed financial data – request audited statements, credit reports, or bank references.
• Single dominant shareholder (70 %) – assess any related‑party risk with Gemilang Holdings.
• Recent settled contract dispute – verify the nature of the breach and any systemic issues. | | **Why they might be a good fit** | • Specialized cold‑chain capability aligns with projects requiring frozen‑goods logistics.
• Long‑standing (since 2007) and active company with stable leadership.
• No current litigation; the only case was settled. | | **Next‑step checklist** | 1. Obtain latest audited financials & cash‑flow statements.
2. Conduct credit check on Gemilang Holdings and the two individual directors.
3. Request references from existing clients in the cold‑chain segment.
4. Verify insurance coverage and compliance with cold‑chain regulations (e.g., HACCP, ISO 22000). | **Bottom line:** Pacific Seri Freight appears to be an established, niche logistics provider with relevant expertise for temperature‑sensitive shipments. The lack of publicly available financials and the presence of a single dominant shareholder warrant deeper due‑diligence before moving forward.
